hypothesis: For liquid listed grid-equipment suppliers, a source-dated comparable increase in transformer or switchgear backlog/book-to-bill together with evidence that delivery-time or commissioned-capacity relief is lagging may predict positive next-open-to-H20 replacement value only when the change is not already represented in pre-event analyst revisions, price/volume and positioning; static AI-power or grid-theme membership is explicitly excluded.
why_not_arbitraged: Backlog, product scope, acquisition effects, delivery constraints and capacity commissioning are disclosed on different clocks and require metric-comparability work; any edge must come from the residual against a contemporaneous observable prior, not from the widely known grid-investment theme.
falsifier: Reject or park the mechanism if the issuer-release source cannot be licensed and reconstructed point in time, if fewer than five executable events touch each canonical window, if delivery proxies stay below 12 months for two quarters while supply growth overtakes demand/backlog, or if the score adds no information beyond pre-event revisions and price.

baseline.policy: Use the current cash-feasible strategy without a grid-backlog event score; for attribution compare static AI-power/grid theme membership and same-sector peers that lack a qualified surprise.
baseline.universe: liquid listed grid-equipment suppliers with source-dated comparable metrics

treatment.policy: On a qualified issuer release, use an LLM only to extract cited product scope, comparable backlog/book-to-bill change, lead-time or capacity-relief state and abstention reasons; a frozen deterministic rule may rank the event only after an independently observable pre-event prior is bound. No LLM output directly authorizes an order.

replacement_value_comparator: Cash, SPY, QQQ, static AI-power/grid peers and the exact cash-feasible core candidate displaced under identical timing, costs and capital constraints.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: unchanged per-source notional caps, portfolio theme cap and one cash-feasible replacement slot
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: canonical cash-equity fees, slippage and next-open timing; no options or leverage
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: liquid listed cash equity of the mapped issuer
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: point-in-time price, spread proxy, ADV and planned participation must be available before any changed decision
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: issuer release, metric extraction, market-prior snapshot and score must all be known before the baseline decision clock

title: Grid backlog and delivery-relief surprise versus observable expectations

prediction.confidence_reason: The physical mechanism is independently documented, but the investable claim is not yet identified: the issuer-release surface is unregistered, estimate and Moomoo coverage do not span the same cohort, and related static AI-power pools are frozen.

reopen_condition: Register an authorized archived issuer backlog/capacity surface for at least 10 listed issuers, bind the same-cohort estimate and price/flow prior, obtain at least five executable touches in every canonical window and 20 independent forward decisions, and keep the top ticker at or below 40 percent.
next_machine_action: Perform a no-ID source-authorization, PIT provenance and density preflight for issuer grid backlog/capacity releases; if it passes, register the source and only then repeat opposite-model debate and D0-D3.
